title: SimBench-BW cross-generation comparability note
description: Per-row note documenting known Hopper-vs-Blackwell behavioral differences that affect the comparability of a portable row's numbers. Template-constrained to prevent prose drift. Required (non-null) for rows that use cp.async.bulk.tensor, clusters, DSMEM, or cluster-scoped mbarrier. An embedded-instance note under a roster row inherits its enclosing schema_version; a standalone note file must declare schema_version explicitly.

schema_version.description: Artifact-instance schema version. Bumped in lockstep with other cross_gen_note-producing tooling so version-drift enforcement holds.

subsystem.description: Subsystem identifier per draft §4b. Matches a primary_subsystem or secondary_subsystem of the declaring row.

hopper_behavior.description: Short prose description of the behavior observed on sm_90a (H100).

blackwell_behavior.description: Short prose description of the behavior observed on sm_120 (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell).

evidence_source.description: Citable evidence — a local artifact path (e.g. results/.../<slug>.json), a KB card path, a peer-reviewed paper identifier (arXiv:YYMM.NNNNN), or a vendor-doc URL.

implication_for_comparability.description: How a simulator or benchmark consumer should interpret the row's Hopper vs Blackwell numbers (e.g. "cross-gen latency drift is within reported envelope; bandwidth ratio means L2-bound kernels compare with a multiplicative factor").
